name: Lenovo ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 12
description: 14" WUXGA IPS, Intel Core Ultra 7 155H, 32GB LPDDR5x, 1TB PCIe Gen4 SSD, Intel Arc Graphics, Thunderbolt 4, WiFi 7, backlit keyboard, fingerprint reader, 57Wh battery, Windows 11 Pro. Ultralight business laptop at just 1.09 kg.

name: Apple MacBook Pro 16" M4 Max
description: 16.2" Liquid Retina XDR, Apple M4 Max 16‑core CPU / 40‑core GPU, 48GB unified memory, 1TB SSD, Thunderbolt 5, MagSafe, 100Wh battery, macOS Sequoia. Pro workstation for developers and creators.

name: Dell OptiPlex 7020 SFF Desktop
description: Small Form Factor, Intel Core i7-14700, 16GB DDR5, 512GB NVMe SSD, Intel UHD Graphics 770, WiFi 6E, Windows 11 Pro. Compact business desktop with tool‑less chassis.

name: Apple iMac 24" M4
description: 24" 4.5K Retina display, Apple M4 10‑core CPU / 10‑core GPU, 16GB unified memory, 512GB SSD, 1080p FaceTime camera, six‑speaker sound system, Magic Keyboard with Touch ID, macOS Sequoia. All-in-one in seven vibrant colors.

name: Samsung Galaxy Tab S10 Ultra
description: 14.6" Dynamic AMOLED 2X 120Hz, MediaTek Dimensity 9300+, 12GB RAM, 512GB storage, S Pen included, IP68, 11200mAh battery, Android 15 with One UI 7. Ultimate Android tablet for productivity and media.

name: Apple iPad Pro 13" M4
description: 13" Ultra Retina XDR tandem OLED, Apple M4 10‑core CPU / 10‑core GPU, 16GB RAM, 1TB, Apple Pencil Pro support, Magic Keyboard compatible, WiFi 6E + 5G, iPadOS 18. The thinnest, most powerful iPad ever.

name: Apple iPhone 16 Pro Max
description: 6.9" Super Retina XDR OLED 120Hz ProMotion, A18 Pro chip, 256GB, 48MP Fusion camera system with 5x Telephoto, USB‑C 3.2, titanium design, iOS 18. The most advanced iPhone camera system ever.

name: Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra
description: 6.9" Dynamic AMOLED 2X 120Hz, Snapdragon 8 Gen 4, 12GB RAM, 512GB, 200MP main + 50MP periscope 10x zoom, S Pen built‑in, titanium frame, IP68, One UI 7 on Android 15. The ultimate Galaxy flagship.

name: Spigen Ultra Hybrid Case for iPhone 16 Pro Max
description: Clear hybrid case with Air Cushion Technology corners. Crystal‑clear polycarbonate back with TPU bumper, raised bezels for screen and camera protection, wireless charging compatible. Minimalist protection that shows off your iPhone.

name: OtterBox Defender Series Case for Galaxy S25 Ultra
description: Multi-layer rugged protection: polycarbonate shell, synthetic rubber slipcover, port covers. Includes belt‑clip holster that doubles as a kickstand. Tested to survive 4x the drops of military standard MIL‑STD‑810G.

name: amFilm Tempered Glass Screen Protector for iPhone 16 Pro Max (2-Pack)
description: 9H hardness tempered glass, 0.33mm ultra‑thin, oleophobic coating, bubble‑free installation kit with alignment frame included. Full coverage, case‑friendly, maintains touch sensitivity and Face ID.

name: Spigen Glas.tR EZ Fit Screen Protector for Galaxy S25 Ultra (2-Pack)
description: 9H tempered glass with auto‑alignment installation tray. Oleophobic coating resists fingerprints, 0.2mm thickness preserves touch sensitivity, works with ultrasonic fingerprint sensor.

name: Sony WH-1000XM6 Wireless Noise Cancelling Headphones
description: Industry‑leading active noise cancellation with Integrated Processor V3, 40h battery (30h with ANC), quick charge (3min = 3h playback), multipoint connection, LDAC / AAC / SBC codecs, Speak‑to‑Chat, wearing detection, foldable design with carry case.

name: Bose QuietComfort Ultra Headphones
description: Immersive spatial audio with head tracking, CustomTune ANC, 24h battery, Snapdragon Sound, aptX Adaptive, Aware Mode, adjustable EQ via Bose Music app, soft cushion ear cups for all‑day wear.

name: JBL Charge 6 Portable Bluetooth Speaker
description: JBL Pro Sound with dual bass radiators, IP68 waterproof and dustproof, 24h playtime, built‑in 10000mAh powerbank (USB‑C out), PartyBoost for stereo pairing, Bluetooth 5.3, rugged fabric design.

name: Sonos Era 300 Spatial Audio Speaker
description: Dolby Atmos spatial audio with six optimally placed drivers, WiFi 6 + Bluetooth 5.2, Trueplay room tuning, USB‑C line‑in, voice control (Sonos Voice + Amazon Alexa). Designed for immersive music and home theater.

name: Apple AirPods Pro 3 with Active Noise Cancellation
description: H3 chip, Adaptive Audio blending ANC and Transparency, Personalized Spatial Audio with dynamic head tracking, USB‑C MagSafe charging case with speaker and lanyard loop, IP54 dust/water resistance, 6h listening (30h with case), Precision Finding with U2 chip.

name: Samsung Galaxy Buds3 Pro
description: Dual drivers (10.5mm woofer + 6.1mm planar tweeter), Adaptive ANC, 360 Audio with head tracking, IP57 water resistance, Galaxy AI features (Live Translate, Interpreter), Blade Light design, 6h ANC playback (30h with case), wireless charging.

name: LG C4 65" OLED evo 4K Smart TV
description: 65" OLED evo panel with Brightness Booster, α9 Gen7 AI Processor 4K, Dolby Vision / Dolby Atmos, 4x HDMI 2.1 (4K@120Hz), G‑Sync / FreeSync Premium, webOS 24 with AI Picture Wizard, Filmmaker Mode. Ideal for next‑gen gaming and cinema.

name: Samsung QN90D 75" Neo QLED 4K Smart TV
description: 75" Neo QLED with Quantum Matrix Technology, NQ4 AI Gen3 Processor, 144Hz Motion Xcelerator, Dolby Atmos, Object Tracking Sound+, 4x HDMI 2.1, Tizen OS, Samsung Gaming Hub with cloud gaming. Brilliant brightness and deep blacks with Mini LED.

name: Apple TV 4K (WiFi + Ethernet)
description: A15 Bionic chip, 128GB storage, 4K HDR10+ / Dolby Vision / Dolby Atmos, Thread smart home networking, Siri Remote with USB‑C, tvOS 18. Acts as a HomeKit home hub with Thread border router. Seamless integration with Apple ecosystem.

name: Google TV Streamer 4K
description: 4K HDR / Dolby Vision / Dolby Atmos, Google TV with AI recommendations, built‑in Thread border router for Matter smart home, voice remote with customizable button, 32GB storage, supports all major streaming apps. The fastest Google streaming device yet.

name: Premium Cotton Oxford Dress Shirt — White
description: 100% long‑staple cotton oxford weave, button‑down collar, chest pocket, split back yoke with box pleat, adjustable two‑button barrel cuffs. Pre‑washed for softness, no‑iron finish. Timeless business‑casual staple.

name: Relaxed-Fit Linen Casual Shirt — Beige
description: 100% European linen, relaxed fit, spread collar, mother‑of‑pearl buttons, curved hem. Breathable, naturally thermoregulating fabric perfect for warm weather. Pairs with chinos or shorts.

name: Slim-Fit Stretch Chinos — Khaki
description: Cotton‑elastane twill with 2% stretch for all‑day comfort. Slim through hip and thigh with tapered leg, mid‑rise waist, hidden closure. Machine washable, wrinkle‑resistant finish. Versatile office‑to‑weekend pant.

name: Japanese Selvedge Raw Denim Jeans — Indigo
description: 14oz unsanforized Japanese selvedge denim from Okayama, regular straight fit, high rise, hidden rivets, chain‑stitched hem, button fly. Develops unique personal fades over time. Rope‑dyed indigo, leather patch.

name: Waxed Canvas Field Jacket — Olive
description: British Millerain 8oz waxed canvas, cotton‑lined, corduroy collar, four bellows pockets, adjustable cuffs and waist, brass YKK zipper with storm flap. Water‑repellent, wind‑resistant. Ages beautifully with wear.

name: Technical Down Parka — Black
description: Pertex Quantum shell, 800‑fill power responsibly‑sourced goose down, DWR finish, fully seam‑sealed, helmet‑compatible hood, internal stash pockets, two‑way front zip, articulated sleeves. Rated to -30°C. Packs into its own pocket.

name: Silk Wrap Midi Dress — Floral Print
description: 100% mulberry silk charmeuse, true wrap silhouette with self‑tie waist, bishop sleeves, midi length, French seams. Hand‑painted floral print exclusive to this collection. Lined bodice. Dry clean.

name: Ribbed Knit Maxi Dress — Black
description: Sustainable TENCEL™ Lyocell rib knit, slim fit, scoop neckline, sleeveless, ankle length, side slit for movement. Ultra‑soft, breathable, seasonless layering piece. Machine wash cold.

name: Silk Charmeuse Blouse — Ivory
description: 22 momme mulberry silk charmeuse, relaxed fit, notched collar, covered button placket, French cuffs, curved shirttail hem. Luxury workwear staple that transitions effortlessly to evening.

name: Organic Cotton Breton Stripe Tee
description: GOTS‑certified organic cotton jersey, classic boat neck, 3/4 sleeves, navy on cream stripe. Garment‑washed for a lived‑in feel. Fair Trade Certified™. The quintessential French‑inspired wardrobe essential.

name: Accordion Pleated Midi Skirt — Wine
description: Lightweight polyester georgette with sharp accordion pleats, elasticated waistband with satin ribbon tie, midi length, lining to knee. Swishes beautifully with movement. Dress up with heels or down with sneakers.

name: Denim A‑Line Mini Skirt — Medium Wash
description: 12oz rigid denim, A‑line silhouette, front patch pockets, raw hem, five‑pocket styling, YKK zipper with shank button. Non‑stretch for authentic vintage denim character. Pairs with everything.

name: Nike Air Max Pulse — Obsidian/White
description: Breathable mesh upper with leather overlays, visible Max Air unit in heel, foam midsole, rubber waffle outsole, padded collar. Retro‑inspired street style with modern comfort. True to size.

name: adidas Samba OG — Cloud White / Green
description: Full‑grain leather upper, suede T‑toe overlay, gum rubber cupsole, gold foil Samba branding, textile lining. The iconic terrace trainer unchanged since the 1950s. Narrow fit — size up half.

name: Red Wing Iron Ranger — Amber Harness
description: Amber Harness oil‑tanned leather, Goodyear welt construction, cork nitrile outsole, triple‑stitched seams, nickel eyelets and speed hooks, leather insole that molds to your foot. Made in USA. Sizing: order 0.5–1 size down.

name: Blundstone 585 Classic Chelsea Boot — Rustic Brown
description: Premium water‑resistant leather, dual‑side elastic gore, removable Comfort Lite footbed, SPS Max Comfort polyurethane midsole/outsole, steel shank. Pull‑on Chelsea boot slip‑resistant and ready for anything. Australian icon since 1870.

name: Birkenstock Arizona Soft Footbed — Sandcastle
description: Oiled nubuck leather upper, anatomically shaped cork‑latex footbed with additional foam layer, suede footbed lining, two adjustable buckled straps, lightweight EVA sole. The legendary two‑strap sandal, now with extra cushioning.

name: Teva Original Universal Sandal — Black
description: Quick‑dry polyester webbing straps, Universal Strapping System with multiple adjustment points, EVA foam footbed, Durabrasion Rubber outsole, recycled polyester lining. Water‑ready adventure sandal. Vegan.

name: The Midnight Library — Matt Haig
description: Between life and death there is a library. When Nora Seed finds herself in the Midnight Library, she has a chance to undo her regrets and live the lives she might have had. A poignant, uplifting novel about the choices that shape us. International bestseller.

name: Project Hail Mary — Andy Weir
description: Ryland Grace wakes up alone on a spaceship with no memory of how he got there. Tasked with saving humanity from extinction, he must use science, humor, and an unlikely ally to solve an interstellar mystery. From the bestselling author of The Martian.

name: Exhalation: Stories — Ted Chiang
description: Nine breathtaking stories from the Hugo and Nebula award‑winning author of Arrival. Tales of time travel, free will, artificial intelligence, and parallel universes that explore what it means to be human. Masterful, mind‑bending speculative fiction.

name: Tenth of December — George Saunders
description: A National Book Award finalist collection of short stories that blend the absurd, the comic, and the deeply human. Saunders navigates the fault lines of contemporary America with empathy, wit, and a uniquely inventive voice.

name: A Brief History of Time — Stephen Hawking
description: The landmark bestseller that has captivated millions. From the Big Bang to black holes, Hawking explores the universe's deepest mysteries in clear, accessible language. Updated edition includes the latest advances in theoretical physics.

name: The Pragmatic Programmer, 20th Anniversary Edition — David Thomas & Andrew Hunt
description: The classic that launched a thousand careers, fully updated for 2024. Covers personal responsibility, career development, architectural techniques, and pragmatic approaches to writing better software. Required reading for every developer.

name: Sapiens: A Brief History of Humankind — Yuval Noah Harari
description: How did Homo sapiens come to dominate the planet? Harari traces our journey from insignificant apes to rulers of the world, examining the revolutions — cognitive, agricultural, scientific — that shaped our history and future. A global phenomenon.

name: The Wager: A Tale of Shipwreck, Mutiny and Murder — David Grann
description: From the #1 New York Times bestselling author of Killers of the Flower Moon. The true story of a British warship that wrecked on a Patagonian island in 1742, and the two opposing crews that survived — each accusing the other of mutiny.

name: University Physics with Modern Physics, 15th Edition — Young & Freedman
description: The gold standard for calculus‑based introductory physics. Clear explanations, rich problem sets, and Mastering Physics integration. Covers mechanics, thermodynamics, electromagnetism, optics, and modern physics. Used in top universities worldwide.

name: Linear Algebra Done Right, 4th Edition — Sheldon Axler
description: The revolutionary textbook that teaches linear algebra through vector spaces and linear maps, de‑emphasizing determinants. Rigorous yet accessible, with over 350 exercises. Ideal for a second course or self‑study. Open access online version available.

name: GMAT Official Guide 2025 Bundle
description: The definitive prep from the makers of the GMAT exam. Includes the main Official Guide, Quantitative Review, and Verbal Review — over 1,500 real GMAT questions with detailed answer explanations, online question bank, and diagnostic evaluation.

name: The Official Digital SAT Study Guide, 2025 Edition
description: Official College Board guide for the digital SAT. Includes 4 full‑length adaptive practice tests, 300+ practice questions with explanations, test‑taking strategies, and access to the Bluebook™ testing app. Aligned with the new digital format.

name: West Elm Haven 3‑Seater Sofa — Performance Velvet, Ink Blue
description: Hand‑built hardwood frame with reinforced joinery, high‑resilience foam cushions with fiber wrap, performance velvet upholstery (stain‑resistant, 100k+ double rubs). Mid‑century modern profile with tapered solid wood legs. Seat depth: 56 cm.

name: Nelson Platform Bench — American Walnut
description: Designed by George Nelson in 1946. Solid American walnut slats with ebonized wood base. 122 cm × 46 cm. A versatile icon of mid‑century modern design — use as a coffee table, bench, or display plinth. Herman Miller authentic.

name: Avocado Green Mattress — Queen
description: GOTS‑certified organic cotton and wool, GOLS‑certified organic latex, 1,414 pocketed support coils in 5 zones, needle‑tufted by hand. Medium‑firm feel, GREENGUARD Gold certified, vegan option available. 25‑year warranty. Made in California.

name: MALM 6‑Drawer Dresser — White Stained Oak Veneer
description: Clean, timeless design with six spacious drawers that run smoothly on metal glides with integrated soft‑close. 160 × 78 × 48 cm. Coordinates with the entire MALM bedroom series. Can be used anywhere in the home.

name: HAY J110 Dining Chair — Natural Oak
description: Solid oak frame with molded oak veneer seat and backrest. Designed by Jørgen Bækmark in the 1950s. Generously proportioned and stackable (up to 8). Warm natural oil finish. Timeless Scandinavian simplicity for the modern kitchen.

name: Muuto Fiber Armchair — Black / Black Leather
description: Innovative wood‑fiber composite shell with 25% wood fibers, upholstered in black aniline leather. Sleek, sculptural Scandinavian design by Iskos‑Berlin. The shell curves smoothly into armrests. Stackable, with powder‑coated steel tube legs.

name: Le Creuset Signature Enameled Cast Iron Dutch Oven — 5.5 qt, Marseille Blue
description: The iconic French oven trusted by chefs worldwide. Sand‑colored interior enamel resists chipping and staining, tight‑fitting lid with integrated steam circulation spikes, ergonomic stainless steel knob oven‑safe to 260°C. Induction‑compatible. Lifetime warranty.

name: All‑Clad D3 Stainless 3‑Ply Fry Pan — 12"
description: Tri‑ply bonded construction: stainless steel layers sandwich a pure aluminum core for even, warp‑free heating. Flared sides for easy tossing, riveted stainless handle. Dishwasher safe, induction ready, oven/broiler safe to 315°C. Made in USA.

name: Wüsthof Classic 8" Chef's Knife
description: Precision‑forged from a single piece of high‑carbon stainless steel (X50CrMoV15), 58 HRC Rockwell hardness, full tang with triple‑riveted POM handle. Precision Edge Technology (PEtec) for exceptional sharpness out of the box. The workhorse of every kitchen.

name: Vitamix A3500 Ascent Series Blender — Brushed Stainless
description: Professional‑grade 2.2 HP motor, variable speed control + 5 program settings (Smoothie, Hot Soup, Frozen Dessert, Dip/Spread, Self‑Cleaning), wireless connectivity, 64 oz Low‑Profile container, self‑detect technology. 10‑year full warranty.

name: Monstera deliciosa — Swiss Cheese Plant, 6" Pot
description: The iconic tropical houseplant with dramatic, fenestrated leaves. Thrives in bright indirect light, water when top 2" of soil is dry. Live plant shipped in 6" nursery pot with care guide. Air‑purifying, pet‑friendly when out of reach. Height: 30–40 cm.

name: Organic Vegetable Seed Starter Kit — 12 Varieties
description: Heirloom, non‑GMO, USDA certified organic seeds: Tomatoes, Basil, Bell Peppers, Kale, Carrots, Radishes, Lettuce Mix, Cucumbers, Zucchini, Green Beans, Swiss Chard, Cilantro. Includes biodegradable peat pots and planting instructions. Germination guarantee.

name: FELCO F‑2 Classic Manual Pruning Shears
description: The world's best‑selling professional pruner. Forged aluminum handles, hardened steel blade with wire cutting notch, sap groove, micrometric blade adjustment, replaceable parts. Cuts up to 25mm diameter. Swiss made, 100% refurbishable. Lifetime durability.

name: GARDENA Comfort Hose Reel with 25m Hose
description: Wall‑mounted hose reel with 180° swivel, integrated hose guide, anti‑drip device, and 25m of premium GARDENA Comfort HighFLEX hose (burst pressure 25 bar, UV‑resistant). Includes wall bracket, 2 hose connectors, and spray nozzle. German engineering.

name: Peloton Bike+
description: 24" rotating HD touchscreen, auto‑follow resistance, Apple GymKit integration, 4‑speaker sound system, 3.5mm headphone jack, Bluetooth 5.0. Access 10,000+ live and on‑demand classes. Compact 122 × 61 cm footprint. 30‑day home trial.

name: Concept2 RowErg — Standard Legs
description: The gold standard indoor rower used by Olympic athletes. PM5 performance monitor with Bluetooth/ANT+, adjustable flywheel damper, ergonomic handle, nickel‑plated chain, quick‑release frame separates into two pieces for storage. Made in USA.

name: Manduka PRO Yoga Mat — 6mm, Midnight
description: High‑density 6mm cushion, closed‑cell surface prevents sweat and bacteria absorption, lifetime guarantee. 180 × 66 cm. Ultra‑dense core provides unmatched comfort and joint protection. OEKO‑TEX certified, emissions‑free manufacturing. The last mat you'll ever buy.

name: Liforme Original Yoga Mat — Green
description: Patented AlignForMe alignment system printed directly on the natural rubber surface. 4.2mm thick, 185 × 68 cm, extra‑large for freedom of movement. Eco‑polyurethane top layer with 'GripForMe' technology — grip improves when wet. Includes free yoga bag.

name: MSR Hubba Hubba 3‑Person Backpacking Tent
description: Freestanding 3‑season tent, 1.84 kg minimum weight, Easton Syclone poles, DuraShield‑coated rainfly and floor, two large StayDry doors with vestibules, unified hub‑and‑pole system for lightning‑fast setup. True‑to‑size: fits three 183cm adults.

name: Therm‑a‑Rest NeoAir XLite NXT Sleeping Pad — Regular
description: R‑value 4.5 for true 3‑season comfort, 7.6cm thick, Triangular Core Matrix construction, WingLock valve with lightning‑fast inflation/deflation, 340g. Quiet and comfortable — the best warmth‑to‑weight ratio on the market. Stuff sack and repair kit included.

name: Osprey Atmos AG 65 Backpack — Men's
description: Anti‑Gravity™ suspended mesh backpanel for unmatched ventilation, Fit‑on‑the‑Fly™ adjustable hipbelt and harness, Stow‑on‑the‑Go™ trekking pole attachment, dual access stretch mesh side pockets, integrated raincover, floating top lid. 65L volume.

name: Black Diamond Distance Carbon Z Trekking Poles — Pair
description: 100% carbon fiber shafts, Z‑Pole rapid deployment system, lightweight EVA foam grip with breathable strap, interchangeable carbide Tech Tips, 120cm fixed length, 285g per pole. Fold to 37cm. The lightest, most packable pole in the Distance series.

name: Nike Flight Premier League 2025 Official Match Ball
description: AerowSculpt technology with molded grooves for truest flight. 4‑panel construction with seamless bonded surface for larger sweet spot. All Conditions Control (ACC) 3D‑printed ink coating for consistent grip wet or dry. FIFA Quality Pro certified.

name: adidas Predator Elite FG — Firm Ground Boots
description: HybridTouch 2.0 upper with Strikeskin rubber fins for controlled swerve. Lightweight CONTROLFRAME 2.0 outsole with external heel counter. Laceless, sock‑fit collar. The boot that defined a generation of playmakers. Size UK 9.

name: Spalding TF‑1000 Classic Indoor Basketball — Official Size 7
description: The official ball of the NBA G League and top high school/college programs. ZK microfiber composite leather cover, wide channels for superior grip, moisture‑management technology, true bounce. NFHS approved.

name: Nike LeBron NXXT Gen AMPD Basketball Shoes — Men's
description: Zoom Air unit in forefoot + large Max Air unit in heel, breathable mesh upper with synthetic overlays, midfoot shank for torsional support, herringbone traction pattern. Engineered for the modern versatile big. Size US 11.

name: CeraVe Hydrating Facial Cleanser — 473 ml
description: Developed with dermatologists. Non‑foaming, creamy formula with 3 essential ceramides and hyaluronic acid to cleanse and hydrate without disrupting the protective skin barrier. Fragrance‑free, non‑comedogenic, suitable for normal to dry skin.

name: La Roche‑Posay Anthelios UVMune 400 Invisible Fluid SPF50+
description: Ultra‑light fluid with patented Mexoryl 400 filter providing protection against ultra‑long UVA rays. SPF50+, very high protection, water‑resistant, non‑greasy, no white cast. Suitable for sensitive skin. Fragrance‑free. 50ml.

name: Olaplex No.3 Hair Perfector — 100 ml
description: At‑home bond‑building treatment that repairs broken disulfide bonds in all hair types. Reduces breakage, strengthens, and visibly improves texture and shine. Use weekly before shampooing. Salon‑grade results, fragrance‑free. Cruelty‑free, vegan.

name: OUAI Fine Hair Shampoo — 300 ml
description: Weightless volumizing shampoo with hydrolyzed keratin, biotin, and chia seed oil. Strengthens fine hair, adds body and shine without stripping. Sulfate‑free, color‑safe, with the signature OUAI Mercer Street fragrance. For fine to medium hair types.

name: Charlotte Tilbury Matte Revolution Lipstick — Pillow Talk
description: The iconic nude‑pink that suits every skin tone. Buildable matte finish, lip‑shaped bullet for precise application, enriched with orchid extract and 3D glowing pigments. Long‑lasting, hydrating matte that doesn't feather. 3.5g.

name: NARS Light Reflecting Advanced Skincare Foundation — Mont Blanc
description: Buildable medium coverage with a natural, skin‑like finish. Light‑reflecting complex blurs imperfections, while biomimetic oat and milk thistle help protect against environmental stressors. 30ml. 36 shades available. Non‑comedogenic, dermatologist tested.

name: CATAN — Base Game, 5th Edition
description: The legendary strategy board game of trading, building, and settling. 3-4 players, ages 10+, 60-90 minutes. Collect resources, trade with opponents, build roads and settlements. Every game is unique thanks to the modular, variable board. Over 40 million sold worldwide.

name: Wingspan — Board Game
description: An award‑winning, engine‑building board game about birds. 1-5 players, ages 14+, 40-70 minutes. Attract birds to your wildlife preserve, collect food, lay eggs. Stunning artwork and 170 unique bird cards with real ornithological facts. 2019 Kennerspiel des Jahres winner.

name: PlayStation 5 Slim Digital Edition Console
description: Slimmer, lighter PS5 with 1TB SSD. Experience lightning‑fast loading, haptic feedback, adaptive triggers, and 3D Audio. Supports 4K 120Hz and ray tracing. Includes DualSense wireless controller. The best place to play PlayStation exclusives.

name: Xbox Series X 2TB — Galaxy Black Special Edition
description: The most powerful Xbox ever, now with 2TB SSD. True 4K gaming, up to 120 FPS, 8K HDR, DirectX ray tracing, Quick Resume, backwards compatible with thousands of games. Includes Xbox Wireless Controller. Galaxy Black speckle finish.

name: STIGA Crusader Outdoor Table Tennis Table
description: Full‑size 274 × 152.5 × 76 cm outdoor table. 4mm aluminum composite top with UV protection, 38mm powder‑coated steel frame, 8 locking wheels for easy mobility, dual safety anti‑tilting system. Includes net and post set. 10‑minute assembly.

name: Nerf Elite 2.0 Turbine CS‑18 Motorized Blaster
description: Fully motorized dart blasting with 18‑dart clip, fires darts up to 27 meters. Includes 36 Official Nerf Elite darts. Motorized flywheel system — hold down the acceleration button, then pull the trigger. Ages 8+. Requires 4 C batteries (not included).

name: WeatherTech DigitalFit Floor Liners — Front & Rear Set
description: Laser‑measured for a perfect fit. High‑density tri‑extruded (HDTE) material with advanced surfacing creates channels that carry fluids and debris to a lower reservoir. Patented retention device secures liners in place. For Toyota RAV4 2019-2025.

name: Garmin Dash Cam Mini 3
description: Tiny dash cam (size of a car key) with 1080p HDR video, 140‑degree wide lens, Parking Guard mode, voice control, automatic incident detection (G‑sensor saves footage on impact), WiFi for Garmin Drive app connectivity. Includes 16GB microSD card.

name: Shoei RF‑1400 Helmet — Matte Black
description: Premium full‑face motorcycle helmet. Multi‑ply Matrix AIM+ shell, dual‑layer EPS liner, CWR‑F2 visor with Pinlock 120 anti‑fog insert, 3D Max‑Dry interior system, E.Q.R.S. emergency quick‑release cheek pads. Snell M2025D & DOT approved. Size M.

name: Pirelli Scorpion Trail II Tires — Set (Front 120/70R19 + Rear 170/60R17)
description: Sport‑touring dual‑compound radial tires for adventure motorcycles. High‑silica compound for excellent wet grip, adaptive tread pattern, stable handling on‑road and light off‑road. Ideal for BMW GS, Triumph Tiger, Ducati Multistrada.
